def unregister(self, itemtype, item_id):
        """
        deregister the item in zookeeper /list/
        itemtype must be a Zooborg constant
        item_id must be a string
        """
        if itemtype not in self.itemtypes:
            raise ValueError("itemtype must be a Zooborg constant")
        if not isinstance(item_id, str):
            raise ValueError("item_id must be a string")
        self.zk.delete(self.list_path + itemtype + "/" + item_id)
